s: System that generates personalized item suggestions using collaborative filtering, content-based, or hybrid ML approaches.
w: Collects user interaction signals (clicks, purchases, ratings, time spent). Collaborative filtering finds similar users/items from the interaction matrix. Content-based models match item features to user profiles. Hybrid approaches combine both. Models retrain periodically on fresh data. Results are cached per user and served from a fast store (Redis, feature store). Real-time signals (current session) can boost or re-rank cached recommendations.
use: E-commerce product recommendations (frequently bought together, personalized for you)
Content platforms: video, article, music recommendations (YouTube, Netflix, Spotify)
Social feeds ranked by predicted engagement
Ad targeting and creative selection optimization
avoid: Cold-start scenarios with no user history (use content-based or popularity fallback)
Small catalogs where simple rule-based recommendations suffice
Real-time per-request model inference without pre-computation (too slow for interactive use)

pat.d: User/item features from feature store power real-time model inference.

pits: Cold-start problem for new users/items - implement fallback strategies (popularity, content-based)
Filter bubbles from pure collaborative feedback - add exploration/diversity signals
tips: Two-stage architecture: candidate generation (fast, broad) then ranking (slow, precise)
Offline evaluation metrics (precision@K, NDCG) vs online A/B tests - mention both
